PLF-087.name: Fix GitHub synchronization after Planfile ticket archival
PLF-087.description:
Reproduction: complete a Planfile ticket with an existing GitHub sync mapping. Planfile moves it from current.yaml to a history sprint; `planfile sync github --direction to` then reports no local tickets and leaves the GitHub issue open.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Sync discovers mapped tickets in active and archived/history sprints.
2. A completed ticket closes its mapped GitHub issue.
3. A dry run reports the intended close without mutating GitHub.
4. Add a regression test covering the archival path.
